indicators.label: Church of Sweden members
indicators.description: Published Church of Sweden administrative membership count.
indicators.method: Printed member count carried verbatim; no recomputation.
indicators.temporal_coverage: Annual 1972-2025; the source prints no metrics for 1981.

indicators.label: Church of Sweden membership share
indicators.description: Published Church of Sweden members as a percentage of the population.
indicators.method: Printed percentage carried verbatim; never recomputed or re-rounded.
indicators.temporal_coverage: Annual 1972-2025; the source prints no metrics for 1981.
indicators.quality_notes: The source prints no population denominator.

visual_layers.label: Church of Sweden membership share
visual_layers.aggregation_rule: use the source's printed national percentage
visual_layers.notes: The source prints no metrics for 1981.

rows.population_total_basis: The Church of Sweden source prints a member count and a membership share of the population, but it prints no population base. This product never derives a count or denominator from a percentage.
